posts.text: I also have a lot of regrets almost a decade since my dad’s passing. My family should have forced him to step down the second he was diagnosed. Which is why I’m now an advocate for age and term limits in politics. I also sincerely hope Senator McConnell is ok.
posts.summary: Advocates for age and term limits in Congress
posts.quote: I also have a lot of regrets almost a decade since my dad’s passing. My family should have forced him to step down the second he was diagnosed. Which is why I’m now an advocate for age and term limits in politics. I also sincerely hope Senator McConnell is ok.

posts.text:
I also remember my family telling the world my dad’s Glioblastoma brain cancer diagnosis within 48 hours of our family finding out. 

I regret poking fun at the joke the entire internet is making - I can understand as McConnell’s former staffer how hard it must be to see that.
posts.summary: Expresses concern about McConnell's health and transparency

In all seriousness, Senator McConnell's staff owes it to the American public to give a real update on his health or show us some kind of proof of life. 

All of this is unseemly, macabre, bad for democracy and quite frankly embarrassing for the country.

congress-legislation.quote: I also have a lot of regrets almost a decade since my dad’s passing. My family should have forced him to step down the second he was diagnosed. Which is why I’m now an advocate for age and term limits in politics. I also sincerely hope Senator McConnell is ok.

I also remember my family telling the world my dad’s Glioblastoma brain cancer diagnosis within 48 hours of our family finding out. 

I regret poking fun at the joke the entire internet is making - I can understand as McConnell’s former staffer how hard it must be to see that.

In all seriousness, Senator McConnell's staff owes it to the American public to give a real update on his health or show us some kind of proof of life. 

All of this is unseemly, macabre, bad for democracy and quite frankly embarrassing for the country.
